# LemonMCP

> Public, local stdio MCP server for Lemon on a real iPhone. Read this index before attempting a connection, traffic inspection, Rewrite, scripting, Replay, DNS, or Module operation.

## Use without MCP

- [Lemon Skill entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/skills/lemon/SKILL.md)
- [Direct HTTP connection and secure input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/skills/lemon/references/connection.md)

- [Task workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/skills/lemon/references/workflows.md)
- [Replay Workspace definitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/skills/lemon/references/replay-workspace.md)
- [All-capability manual routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/skills/lemon/references/documentation.md)

The Skill can use direct WebControl HTTP with Python 3.10+ and no MCP installation. The execution environment must reach the iPhone LAN. It supports local hidden terminal input; it does not add a universal password dialog. Install the complete skill folder, or read its entry and linked references online.

## Exact references

- [Current tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/docs/reference/tools.md)

- [Rewrite rules and action configs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/docs/reference/rewrite-rules.md)
- [Script API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/docs/reference/script-api.md)
- [脚本 API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/docs/reference/script-api.zh-CN.md)
- [Remote script lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemonXGroup/lemon-mcp/main/docs/reference/remote-scripts.md)

For Rewrite matching, read the rule reference before generating conditions. Query matches the raw query without the leading ?. Host eq/prefix/suffix/contains support * and ?; eq *.example.com includes the root and all subdomains. The other operators retain string-position semantics. Public MCP upsert verifies device host_wildcards support before saving; direct HTTP callers must check capabilities themselves. Without request-target actions, wildcard shares use schema 5 and backups use version 6; query adds no portable version and older clients reject the field.

For target changes, read request-target.md: redirect is actual HTTP 3xx (default 307), url_rewrite is internal upstream modification, and query_mod edits ordered entries. Existing redirect uses the same identifier and missing-field defaults, with no migration action. Target actions use portable/DRM schema 6 and backup/recovery 7; check request_target_rewrite version 1.

## Operating principles

Check the actual installed tools; the current public source registers 70 tools and 2 resources. The iPhone and local MCP host must be reachable on the LAN, Remote Controller must be Listening, and authenticated calls require the current phone token. Receive the token only through local configuration or a supported local secure input flow; do not ask for it in chat. The MCP snapshot has no token dialog; the optional Skill helper supports hidden input in a user-operated interactive terminal. Verify authenticated device state, not only a public status probe.

Use authorized actions and verify persistence, runtime application, and new request evidence separately. Do not invent App-equivalent tools. Read the relevant rule/script contract before generating code. If online access is unavailable, read these same files in the local installation. Public URLs become available after this content is published to main.
